category_title: Students who engage in high social interaction but require frequent off-task redirection
scenario_title: Individualistic approach and frustration during team tasks
minimal_context: The student is assigned to work on a collaborative social studies task with peers in a mixed-age classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start working on your collaborative social studies task as a team.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to work independently on my section. We can just fit all the pieces together in the end.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Remember, this is supposed to be a team effort. Try talking to your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Communicating with them is tedious. I get 'easily frustrated' and have a 'hard time' working with others.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to help your peers with the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to be 'dragged down' by everyone else because I normally work faster. I know it's my 'stubbornness', but I'm doing this on my own.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please start working on your collaborative social studies task as a team.

STUDENT: I'm just going to work independently on my section. We can just fit all the pieces together in the end.

TUTOR: Remember, this is supposed to be a team effort. Try talking to your group.

STUDENT: Communicating with them is tedious. I get 'easily frustrated' and have a 'hard time' working with others.

TUTOR: You need to help your peers with the assignment.

STUDENT: I don't want to be 'dragged down' by everyone else because I normally work faster. I know it's my 'stubbornness', but I'm doing this on my own.

task.learning_goal: To be completed as a team

context.social_setting: Working on a collaborative task as a team

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Even though students understand that the task is to be completed as a team
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Choosing to working independently with the understanding that they would just fit all the pieces together in the end
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Admitted to 'stubbornness' as a weakness; don't want to be 'dragged down' by others

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: They only did so when prompted; when students communicated with peers, it was in a tedious fashion
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Having 'hard time' or were 'easily frustrated' when working with others
